title: Design a no-behavior-change structure pass for gh.rs and run.rs
summary: Write docs/design/structure-pass.md proposing module boundaries for gh.rs (host client, landing, early PR and CI wait, records writes) and run.rs (producer, checks, verification, send-back), an ordered list of single-producer-sized move jobs, and a per-move proof of no behavior change. Add a proposed (not accepted) entry to docs/decisions.md and a CHANGELOG.md line. Audience is Sri, who will approve the jobs; no code changes.

defaults_applied.how: Design written with alternatives before any build.
Counts and callers cited from the files, measured or labeled estimates.
Each move's no-change proof is a test/grep outcome, not file existence.
Moves sized as separate single-producer jobs.
Doc written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Design only: no Rust code is moved in this job; the moves become later jobs.
Sri is the audience and approves the plan before jobs are queued.
Line counts in the request are taken as stated but the doc re-measures them.
Decision entry is marked proposed since the owner has not accepted it.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/structure-pass.md names each proposed module for gh.rs and run.rs, lists which functions/types move into each (cited from the current files with measured line/function counts), and gives alternatives considered.

The doc orders the moves as numbered jobs, each sized for one producer run, with dependencies and the riskiest moves (caller-heavy functions) identified, and splits produce_and_verify into stages by named seams.

For each move the doc states how no behavior change is shown: existing tests pass unchanged, only import/use lines edited in tests, public paths re-exported so callers do not change, cargo clippy and fmt --check clean, and a caller check (grep of old paths) listed.
docs/decisions.md has a new entry marked proposed, with context, decision, alternatives and consequences, linking the design doc and the design-review cadence job 20261017-205558-dn2e.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the design doc; no source, test, athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow file is changed.
Run git diff --stat / git status: only the three listed docs files changed; cargo test and cargo fmt --check still pass.

out_of_scope: Moving any code or editing tests
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time: the planned moves target the files behind repeated critic-found missed callers and this week's rejected or broken landings.
